items.title: What Could Walt Disney (DIS) AI Push Mean For Its Creative Future?
items.summary: Adobe and Walt Disney (NYSE:DIS) announced a new multi-year alliance to deploy AI tools for Disney creatives on 9 November 2026. The partnership will bring Adobe AI software into Disney film, TV, parks, cruise development and marketing workflows. Disney creative teams are expected to use Adobe tools for script development support, visual effects workflows and content localization. items.title: Palantir Rises 5%, Snowflake Up 6% as AI Stocks Rebound After Market Was “Freaking Out”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPalantir rose 5% today with no news of its own, as Cloudflare, Snowflake and other AI stocks rebounded from last week’s selloff. That selloff came after a quarter in which Palantir’s revenue grew 96%.
